publications.title: Heart Rate Pattern Analysis for Seizure Detection: A Case Study Using Wearable Technology
publications.abstract: This study examines heart rate patterns preceding epileptic seizures using long-term monitoring data. Our analysis identified significant changes in heart rate variability preceding seizure events, suggesting potential for early detection systems.
publications.data_usage: We utilized the MirrorHR dataset to train and validate our seizure detection algorithm, specifically using heart rate pattern data from 50+ seizure events to identify predictive markers.

publications.title: Comparative Analysis of Automated Seizure Detection Algorithms Using Consumer Wearables
publications.abstract: This paper presents a comparative evaluation of five different algorithms for automated seizure detection using consumer-grade wearable devices. We evaluated performance using real-world data from epilepsy patients, focusing on sensitivity, specificity, and detection latency.
publications.data_usage: The MirrorHR dataset provided real-world testing data for our algorithm comparison, allowing us to evaluate performance against verified seizure events in uncontrolled environments.
